recipes.name: Easy Shepherd’s Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 cup KRAFT Shredded Cheddar Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Gather all ingredients.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet. Drain grease; return beef to the skillet.
Meanwhile, combine potatoes, cream cheese, ½ cup cheese, and garlic in a bowl until well blended.
Stir vegetables and gravy into ground beef.
Transfer filling to a 9-inch square baking dish.
Cover filling with potato mixture and remaining ½ cup cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 20 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Shepherd’s Pie
raw_recipe.description: This shepherd’s pie has a layer of ground beef in savory gravy with vegetables and a rich and cheesy potato topping for classic comfort food.

review.reviewBody: My husband requested Shepherd's Pie, which is not usually one of my favorites. I tried this recipe and we BOTH loved it! I also added onions while cooking the ground beef and I used Idahoan Roasted Garlic Instant Mashed Potatoes, so I omitted the minced garlic … yummy. Definitely a keeper for us!

We love lots of flavor so when I cooked the meat I added garlic and onion. I also made the beef gravy with 1 cup of beef broth, boiled then added about a tablespoon on corn starch to some warm water, whisked and add to broth. Now add one package of Lipton soup beef and onion. Once this thickens add it to the meat and vegetables. I also used Idaho instant garlic mash potatoes. Lots of warm flavor on a cold night. It was a hit!!

Great casserole for beginner cooks and experienced cooks alike! Affordable ingredients with good flavor mixed all together. The cream cheese creates a creamy dish that sticks together for easy cutting into four to six servings. Ideal for microwaved leftovers. Changes I made were: • Prepared an 8x8 glass Pyrex baking dish with a light brushing of garlic oil olive • Used ground turkey instead of ground beef • Used frozen peas instead of frozen mixed vegetables • Made my own beef gravy with beef stock, onion salt and a corn starch slurry • After cooking, broiled the dish for 4 minutes at about 8” below the broiler • Added sprinkles of parsley after plate up

Made this recipe with a few changes. Didn't have cream cheese, so made mashed potatoes with plant butter and lactose free milk. Daughter needs gf/dairy free. She has plant based shredded cheese so I used that. Added 1 stalk of celery, a medium onion and 15 oz can mixed veggies, plus Worcestershire sauce to meat and brown gravy. The 3 of us loved it! I will try with the instant potatoes with garlic too. Definitely a keeper here! We only had one serving left!

Delicious and so easy to make. First time making shepherds pie. The mashed potatoes did not get the cream cheese or garlic. Instead, I added white pepper. To the meat/veg mix I sautéed and added 1/2 onion chopped and 3 cloves garlic minced, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, 7.5 oz cream of mushroom soup concentrate, 2 Tbsp soy sauce. I topped it all off with grated Colby Jack because that’s what I already had. Maybe next I’ll remember to put the minced garlic in the mashed potatoes, and maybe put grated parm instead. And maybe try some fish sauce in place of the soy sauce.

I tweaked this recipe a bit. I cooked the ground beef seasoned with salt/pepper/garlic seasoning along with onions, minced garlic and fresh green beans. Instead of gravy, I used 3/4 block cream cheese. I also used colorful potato medley for the mashies. Topped with cheddar. Absolutely delicious!

The only thing I did differently was use real russet potatoes and heavy cream. With salt and pepper. I didn’t put any butter in it. I put in peas, green beans, mushrooms, corn, garlic and diced green onions with the meat. I used McCormick Roasted beef Gravy. I put that on last over the pie with cheese. My husband said it tasted better than shepherds pie from Cheesecake Factory. What wonderful praises!!

This is one of the greatest recipes I have ever used! I boiled and mashed russet potatoes instead of using instant; used frozen peas, carrots, and corn (no green beans); and used four cloves of garlic. It was a pot luck hit!
I used lamb and added some sautéed scallions with a bit of fresh thyme and rosemary. I also used a truffle butter in the mashed potatoes. So good!

Always a favorite at my house. We call it Hobo Pie. I don't use gravy though, instead I use cream of mushroom mixed in the meat and just put a layer of corn between the Hamburger and mashed potatoes. Turns out delicious.

This was great. I read other reviews who said it was bland. So I added salt and pepper to the ground beef and Lipton onion soup packet. I used the bob Evans already made mash potatoes. This will definitely become a part of my meals.
This was so easy to make and tasty! I had always had difficulty with shepherd's pie because of the lack of flavor. But the brown gravy put it over the top. This one's A keeper!
Excellent. Used the instant mashed potato version. And we have always just used whole kernel corn with pats of butter ( 4 ) for the veggie. My family and church friends loved it. Thank you.

So fast and easy. I had left over cooked ground meat, frozen mixed vegetables and instant potatoes. The gravy was a package. Next time I would cook the gravy so it was thicker. I added worscestershire sauce. Microwaved 13 minutes.
This was absolutely delicious. I did substitute Tillamook cheese for the Kraft and used better than gravy gravy

I added a panko crumb/cheese/butter topping to the mashed potatoes. Also, to prevent the gravy leaking through the top, it's helpful to cool the meat mixture in the fridge before adding it to the pan and putting the potatoes on top
It's OK.

I left out the cream cheese(calories) and made it gluten free by using beef broth and cornstarch slurry for the gravy. Added Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper, popped it in theoven for 20 min, and BAM! There it was and it was deeeelish! Everything else was the same.

We liked this recipe with some changes. I used ground turkey and cooked it with dried minced onion and minced garlic. I added a bag of frozen peas and carrots to the pan after the turkey was cooked and cooked that for about five minutes. I added beef broth, butter and flour to the same pan to make the gravy. While this was cooking, I boiled potatoes and mashed them with butter and 1/2 and 1/2. I added the shredded sharp cheddar to the hot potatoes and mixed them together. I put the turkey, spices, veggies into a 9x11 pan and added the cheesy mashed potatoes on the top. I sprinkled the remainder of the shredded cheddar on top of that and baked it for 20 minutes. Delicious and a fairly fast and easy recipe.
Excellent! I use a pouch of gravy mix and prepare as directed on the package in the microwave instead of canned gravy. Canned vegetables works just as well as the thawed mixed vegetables.
